_comment: TASK-890 §3.14 (OD-R clause 3) — the CROSS-LANGUAGE parity fixture for the guardrail opt-out's precedence. Asserted from BOTH tests/contracts/guardrail-optout-parity.contract.test.ts (TypeScript, packages/workflow-contract/src/guardrail-optout.ts — the gateway's realtime `core.agent` lane, the agent invocation path and the publish-time finding) and apps/harness/src/harness/tests/unit/temporal/interpreter/test_guardrail_optout_parity.py (Python, harness.temporal.interpreter.guardrail_optout — the durable lane). The two lanes execute the SAME node, so a divergence here means one lane screens a call the other does not, which is a safety difference no test outside this fixture would see. `null` = no opinion at that level (ABSENT means inherit; there is no `unset false`).
